messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: PGD: inference-ingress-prod queue backlog > 95% (avg queue_time 4200ms) across 3 AZs. autoscaler: unable to provision new nodes for the last 11m. Paging on-call. link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD12345 triggered (inference-ingress-prod). Assigned to on-call: Alex H.

Alex H: Acked. On it. First check: autoscaler controller health and recent scale events.

Alex H: Running quick check: `kubectl -n inference get hpa -o wide` and `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=scale-controller`

Alex H: scale-controller pod is Restarting (CrashLoopBackOff) on node gpu-pool-2. See recent logs.

Maria T: @Alex H nice catch. Could be a config change from last deploy. Any configmap diffs?

Kevin L: I pulled logs from scale-controller: `2026-02-14T16:05:12Z ERROR provider: capacity request rejected: instance quota exceeded` then `2026-02-14T16:06:01Z WARN backoff: retrying provisioning`

Alex H: Looks like cloud provider denied instance creation. That would cause autoscaler to saturate queues. Opening cloud console now.

platform-oncall: Confirmed: provider quota for GPU family x1 in region us-west-2 at limit. No new instances allowed. We had burst capacity spend last week.

SRE Lead: Customer impact? Any 5xx spikes or throttles?

Kevin L: Metrics: request latency increased; 503 rate up from 0.2% -> 6% over 8m. Top customer buckets show retries.

Maria T: Adding data: KV cache hit-rate unchanged -> this is capacity, not model issue.

Alex H: Triage plan: 1) Temporarily scale ingress replicas to accept more concurrent connections (avoid immediate 503), 2) manual scale Dedicated pools where possible, 3) request emergency quota increase from cloud support, 4) notify customers if ETA > 30m.

Alex H: Step 1: bump replicas for inference-ingress to 6 -> 12: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-ingress --replicas=12`

Kevin L: Done. Pod provisioning stuck for some GPU-backed pods. cpu-only replicas came up and absorbed some traffic. Latency down to 1800ms, 503s still ~2.8%.

platform-oncall: Manual workarounds: we can failover some traffic to us-east-1 capacity where quota ok, but needs routing change + DB affinity check.

Maria T: Can we use model-fallback policy? Route to quantized variants in us-west that need less GPU memory? That could reduce required nodes.

Alex H: Good idea. Implementing rollout: update routing policy to prefer quantized-128 variant for non-SLA customers. Pushing config update to traffic-router.

Alex H: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.local/routeset -d '{"service":"inference","policy":"quantized-fallback"}'` (mocked)

pagerduty: Update: PD12345 acknowledged by Alex H. Escalation to SRE Lead if not resolved in 20m.

Kevin L: Cloud support ticket opened: CS-87621. Estimated response 45m.

platform-oncall: Submitted emergency quota request too. ETA from provider quoted 2h unless expedite.

Maria T: Impact assessment: 14 customers saw degraded responses; 3 high-traffic customers experienced retries and partial errors. No data exfiltration.

Alex H: I'm going to start failover to us-east for non-sensitive routes. @platform-oncall coordinate the DNS + LB changes.

platform-oncall: Starting DNS steer. Will notify infra-team and update runbook.

SRE Lead: If provider can't raise quota quickly, plan B is manual warm-up of existing spare cards + customer throttling limits. Prepare customer comms.

Alex H: Handing off to platform-oncall for the cross-region failover. I'm staying pinned until PD escalates or cleared. Update me in thread. :thumbsup:

platform-oncall: Handoff ack. Working with Traffic Eng and Support. Notifying affected accounts with temporary mitigation.

pagerduty: PD12345 status: Investigating -> Mitigated (partial). Escalation timer stopped.

Alex H: Thanks team. Follow-up actions: 1) postmortem if quota increase/usage policy needs to change, 2) add autoscaler healthcheck alert (controller pod crash), 3) document emergency quota playbook. Assigning owners: Maria -> postmortem, Kevin -> autoscaler alert, Platform -> quota playbook.

Maria T: Will draft postmortem. Saving logs and dashboards.

Kevin L: I'll add the alert and a runbook snippet for manual scale.

platform-oncall: Will draft quota playbook and contact vendor AM.

SRE Lead: Closing note: nice quick coordination. Keep thread updated with CS ticket and PD resolution.

Alex H: Leaving thread to platform-oncall. If anything else, ping me.
